name: android-foundation
description: Android Foundation — the centerpiece Android (Kotlin + Gradle) stack provider for the Agentic SDLC marketplace. Registers the android profile via manifest.yaml (kind: foundation, aspect: android, priority 300); ships the full specialized agent roster plus convention skills for Compose UI, architecture, data and Navigation. Carries pinned house rules (Coil3, Kermit, KSP, @Serializable routes, DataStore, Play Billing); detect-don't-impose libraries (Retrofit, Room, Dagger/Hilt) attach as additive framework plugins. In-pipeline checks: detekt + unit tests + compile-check (builds CI-deferred).
